Happy Year of the Snake 2025

Welcoming the Year of the Snake with Warm Wishes from Aquasky

As the calendar turns to 2025, we at Aquasky are excited to welcome the Year of the Snake. This year, inspired by the Snake’s attributes of intelligence, charm, and flexibility, we extend our warmest wishes for your prosperity and health.

In the lunar calendar, 2025 (the 114th year of the Republic of China) is the Year of the Snake, the sixth animal in the zodiac. Known for its wisdom, dexterity, and charm, the Snake heralds a year of improved luck and success. Let the spirit of the Snake inspire us all to navigate the year with resilience and grace.

 

Holiday Notice: Aquasky’s Lunar New Year Schedule for 2025

Please note that our offices will be closed from January 25th to February 2nd, 2025, in celebration of the Lunar New Year. We will resume our operations on February 3rd, 2025 ready to continue providing you with top-tier pressure tanks and services.

We appreciate your understanding as our team takes this time to celebrate with their families and recharge for the year ahead. Thank you for your continued trust and support. We look forward to achieving new milestones together in 2025 and bringing you boundless opportunities.
